name: Black Vaughan

attributes.attribute: remained on earth to torment his neighbors
shifted into a fly to drive horses wild
was driven away by a woman with a newborn baby

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Black_Vaughan is a savage ghost from English folklore. He once lived in Lancashire and was vile in life. After death he stayed on earth to torment his neighbors. He could change his shape into a fly to drive their horses wild. A woman holding a newborn baby finally drove him away, for he could not stand her pure and innocent state.

okr.objective: Recount Black_Vaughan as an evil ghost that a woman with a newborn baby drove away.
key_results: Black_Vaughan was a savage ghost in British folklore.
